text: Planning a trip is always an exciting part of the adventure itself. I love researching destinations, booking flights, and imagining the experiences that await. Once I arrive, the real magic begins: immersing myself in new cultures, observing daily life, and trying unfamiliar foods. Sometimes, language barriers create funny misunderstandings, but a smile and a few basic phrases can go a long way. Although challenges exist, they often become the most memorable stories. In the end, the souvenirs fade, but the vivid memories of people, places, and tastes stay with me forever, shaping how I see the world.
